The **Publications** page is now synchronized automatically with **OpenAlex** using my ORCID identifier.

A weekly GitHub Action refreshes publication metadata and citation counts, while filtering out non-publication records that would otherwise clutter the academic list. Google Scholar and HAL remain available as complementary public profiles.
